rationale: Independent reading: held EO 9294 (8 FR 221) further defines ODT functions on local passenger transportation equipment, territories, and requisitioning; no own term. Held EO 9625 (10 FR 12073, signed Sept. 21, 1945) is titled 'Revoking Executive Order 9294 ...' and orders that 'Executive Order 9294 of January 4, 1943 ... be, and it is hereby, revoked'; whole-order, no savings clause. My own status: NO; agree. D6: earlier See-references (EO 8942, 8989, 9040, 9156, 9214) predate it; EO 9462, 9554, 9569, 9570, 9602-9604 merely cite ODT orders issued under EO 9294 as existing law (the machine ACT:...>EO:9570 'terminate' is a false positive); no held text after Sept. 21, 1945 names or revives EO 9294 (other hits are unrelated numbers). Accept.
